pages.text: Mariculture adds a few bits of integration with Botania. You can craft a livingwood fishing rod, which catches Botania loot.
pages.title: Botania Integration

pages.text: As well as this, Mariculture oysters will occasionally produce mana pearls. There is also a fish, the manafish, bred from an electric ray, that produces magic droplets and prismarine shards.
This rod catches a few Botania things like mystical flowers, cosmetics, Gaia discs or even the ring of chordata. Repair it with a manasteel ingot.
pages.title: Livingwood Fishing Rod
